title: A01 Platform tour cheat sheet
subtitle: ASSOCIATE SERIES · A01 · SECTION 1 PLATFORM (6%) QUICK REFERENCE

pages.title: Architecture · Unity Catalog · Delta Lake
lede: Section 1: core components (architecture, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and compute choices.
Free Edition: serverless only, Unity Catalog, one 2X-Small SQL warehouse. Fictional rows only.

blocks.heading: 1. Two planes
blocks.code:
control plane  -> Databricks-managed services + web app (Databricks account)
compute plane  -> where data is processed
  serverless   -> serverless compute plane in the Databricks account
  classic      -> VMs in YOUR cloud account
blocks.note: Account: identity, workspaces, metastores, usage. Workspace: notebooks, jobs, queries, dashboards.

blocks.heading: 2. Unity Catalog three-level namespace
blocks.note: One metastore can attach to several workspaces in the same region. UC governs access, lineage, audit.

blocks.heading: 3. Managed Delta table (no LOCATION = managed)
blocks.note: Delta is the default table format on Databricks. UC manages the files and their lifecycle.

blocks.heading: 4. Inspect it
blocks.code:
DESCRIBE DETAIL study_plan;          -- format = delta, numFiles, sizeInBytes, createdAt
DESCRIBE TABLE EXTENDED study_plan;  -- Type = MANAGED
UPDATE study_plan SET topic = 'Transformation and modeling' WHERE lesson_id = 'A07';
DESCRIBE HISTORY study_plan;         -- 0 CREATE TABLE · 1 WRITE · 2 UPDATE
blocks.note: Delta = Parquet data files + a transaction log: ACID, schema enforcement, versions, time travel.

pages.title: Compute services and cost models

blocks.heading: 5. Compute options
blocks.code:
serverless notebooks   interactive Python/SQL, no config      (Free Edition)
SQL warehouse          SQL, BI, dashboards: serverless | pro | classic
                       Free Edition: ONE warehouse, 2X-Small
all-purpose (classic)  interactive, custom size/runtime, auto termination
jobs compute (classic) created per job run, ends with the run
instance pools         idle instances ready -> faster start
serverless jobs/pipelines  Lakeflow Jobs / pipelines, no infra
blocks.note: Free Edition does not support custom compute: all-purpose, jobs compute and pools are concepts here.

blocks.heading: 6. Cost models
blocks.code:
DBU = Databricks Unit of processing capability, billed per second of use
classic    : DBUs to Databricks + VM cost from your cloud provider
serverless : compute in the Databricks account, covered by the DBU price
jobs compute DBU rate  <  all-purpose DBU rate
pools      : no DBUs while idle, cloud provider still bills instances
blocks.note: Scheduled production work belongs on jobs compute or serverless jobs, not an interactive cluster.

blocks.heading: 7. Free Edition limits
blocks.text: Serverless only · one 2X-Small SQL warehouse · max 5 concurrent job tasks · one active pipeline per type · restricted outbound internet · no account console · daily fair-usage quota (compute pauses, data kept).

blocks.heading: Practice challenge
blocks.text: DELETE rows WHERE weight_pct < 10, then DESCRIBE HISTORY. Answer: 2 rows remain (A02, A07); newest entry is DELETE; read A01 with VERSION AS OF the version before the delete (until VACUUM removes old files).
